items.prompt: Integrate x^x from 0 to 1 and give the closed form.
items.response: The integral of a function is the area under its graph between two values, so we can integrate by parts: take the first part on one side of the integration line, then halve it, add that result to the other side, and divide by 2. The resulting value will be the area underneath the curve from minus infinity to plus infinity. It's a bit more involved than just plugging numbers in, but you can do it if you like: integrate(1+x)dx/3.
